title: SOP-IT-021 User Access Request (DOCX with flowchart)

expected_findings.quote: For privileged (administrator) access, the Information Security team reviews the request after manager approval.
expected_findings.note: The security review step is missing from Figure 1.

expected_findings.quote: The line manager approves or rejects the request within 2 business days.
expected_findings.note: After rejection nothing happens: in Figure 1 the reject step leads nowhere.
No one owns the access review.
